title: DPRM: A Plug-in Doob h transform-induced Token-Ordering Module for Discrete Diffusion Models
abstract: arXiv:2604.24357v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Discrete diffusion models admit many token orders, yet most systems rely on confidence-based decoding. Confidence is a strong and efficient heuristic, but it can be myopic because local certainty does not measure a position's effect on terminal quality. We introduce DPRM (Doob h-transform Process Reward Model), a plug-in token-ordering module induced by a terminal-reward-tilted trajectory distribution. The Doob transform converts terminal reward into a process reward for each candidate position. A compact estimator indexed by generation progress, confidence, and optional positional or task state makes this correction reusable across partial states. DPRM changes only token order; the host architecture, denoising objective, supervision, and token sampler remain fixed. translated_title: DPRM：一种由Doob h变换诱导的离散扩散模型即插即用令牌排序模块
translated_abstract: arXiv:2604.24357v3 公告类型：交叉替换 摘要：离散扩散模型允许多种令牌顺序，但大多数系统依赖基于置信度的解码。置信度是一种强大且高效的启发式方法，但它可能短视，因为局部确定性并不衡量某个位置对最终质量的影响。我们引入了DPRM（Doob h变换过程奖励模型），这是一种由终端奖励倾斜轨迹分布诱导的即插即用令牌排序模块。Doob变换将终端奖励转换为每个候选位置的过程奖励。一个紧凑的估计器，以生成进度、置信度以及可选的定位或任务状态为索引，使得这种修正可以在部分状态中重用。DPRM仅改变令牌顺序；宿主架构、去噪目标、监督和令牌采样器保持不变。我们推导了精确的奖励倾斜定律，并界定了其候选列表和在线近似。在跨越语言、多模态生成的九个近期开源宿主中，我们进行了评估。
tldr: DPRM是一个即插即用模块，通过Doob变换将终端奖励转化为过程奖励，仅调整令牌顺序而不改动模型架构，从而在离散扩散模型中提升生成质量。
en_tdlr: DPRM is a plug-in module that converts terminal rewards into process rewards via the Doob transform, adjusting only token order without altering the model architecture, thereby improving generation quality in discrete diffusion models.
